text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Another step forward toward my 
dream today!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Thanks to visiting Furlong Tower, 
I'm more fired up than ever!
choice_data_list: なんか、すごく元気だな？
なんか、すごく元気だね？
choice_data_list_en: You sure are full of energy, huh?
You're really full of energy, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Have you ever seen the view from the 
observation deck? It's incredible. It's 
just so vast and endless—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Making my name known in such a huge world, 
becoming the ace who smashes 
preconceptions—when I thought about that, 
it really snapped me into focus!

It looks like Katsuragi Ace had a very 
fulfilling break!
